pkgmetadata.longdescription: Provides the open-source LiteLLM SDK, all three command entrypoints, the default Uvicorn gateway, basic configuration and model routing, and health endpoints. It intentionally excludes MCP, custom-code guardrails, Gunicorn and Granian, Focus and Polars integrations, profiling, database and queue extras, enterprise code, SSO, and optional cloud-provider SDKs. Boto3 and Redis are retained only because the minimal gateway imports them during startup; their presence does not enable supported cloud-provider or database feature scope.
